title: Algebraic-closure basis from one compatible root tower
statement: Use the site and size convention [def-weil-size-convention], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the root modules [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf], slice restriction [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] and the internal/sectionwise equivalence [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. Fix a prime ell, a scheme X where ell is invertible in every residue field, and one object W of its small pro-etale site. For every n >= 0 give a section zeta_n of mu_(ell^(n+1))(W) and a module isomorphism e_n from the restricted constant Z/ell^(n+1) unit to the restricted root module. Suppose e_n sends each scalar a on V -> W to a times the restriction of zeta_n and the successive root power sends zeta_(n+1) to zeta_n. Then the prescribed sheafified finite-subextension colimit twist spQbarTwist of [sk-def-sp-tate-twist], restricted to W, is isomorphic to the unit module for the prescribed finite-subextension-valued condensed Qbar coefficient pulled back to X. The isomorphism is linear for the uniquely specified colimit action. In the internal/sectionwise encoding this is an isomorphism from signed degree one to signed degree zero. It asserts no covering family and no separate finite, integral or rational isomorphisms.

proof.text: Apply the positive signed-degree root-basis construction at d=0. Its conclusion is definitionally the requested degree-one isomorphism on W.

lean.statement:
theorem spQbarRootBasis
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (ℓ : X.residueField x)] (W : X.ProEt)
    (ζ : ∀ n : ℕ, (Scheme.purTwistRootsModule X ℓ n).val.obj (op W))
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (SheafOfModules.unit (Scheme.purTwistRing X (Scheme.purTwistFiniteRing X ℓ n))).over W ≅
        (Scheme.purTwistRootsModule X ℓ n).over W)
    (hζ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnityTransition X (ℓ ^ (n + 1)) (ℓ ^ (n + 2))
        (pow_pos (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime).pos _) (pow_pos (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime).pos _)
        (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (Nat.le_succ (n + 1)))).hom.app (op W) (ζ (n + 1)) = ζ n)
    (he : ∀ (n : ℕ) (V : (Over W)ᵒᵖ)
      (a : ((Scheme.purTwistRing X (Scheme.purTwistFiniteRing X ℓ n)).over W).obj.obj V),
      (e n).hom.val.app V a =
        a • (Scheme.purTwistRootsModule X ℓ n).val.map V.unop.hom.op (ζ n)) :
    Nonempty ((spSignedTwist X _ (spQbarTwist X ℓ) 1).over W ≅
      (spSignedTwist X _ (spQbarTwist X ℓ) 0).over W)
